verdict.rationale: Cline exposes programmatic surfaces: a headless CLI, ACP integration, and an SDK-style core engine for building agents. So asking about API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of versioned APIs or a documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
